name: gradara-travel-video
description: Gradara 万圣节旅行短片（Remotion 竖屏 30s）

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts GradaraTrip out/master.mp4 --concurrency=4 --audio-bitrate=320k && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 21 -maxrate 14M -bufsize 28M -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -movflags +faststart out/gradara_travel.mp4
